integrity: The result is a new self-reviewed analytical claim with runnable standard-library verification; it has not been independently audited. Earlier qualitative phenomena and the Poisson formula are not asserted as novel.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for sufficiently small strictly positive rare-to-common Poisson intensity ratio; no explicit optimal smallness threshold.
Two independent homogeneous spatial Poisson species and expected richness only; no assertion for interactions, heterogeneity or empirical finite samples.
A prior qualitative two-species sigmoid phenomenon is credited rather than claimed as new.
Full historical Coleman papers not inspected; possible broader coverage remains a documented originality risk.
title: Two separated elasticity turning points in a rare–common species–area model
